name: branding-navy-glass-cards-over-street-portrait-campaign
title: Navy Card and Glass Card over Street Portrait
whatItIs: A low-angle photo of a smiling woman in a blue jacket holding a phone in a transit station, with a navy rounded card reading 'Spend with more control.' and a frosted glass card with a glossy coin and 'One wallet. More control.'
whatItMeans: Colour-matched wardrobe and glass cards tie the photo to the brand, and the low angle feels aspirational.
techniques: Two card styles (solid navy, frosted glass) over one photo
Italic serif word inside a sans headline
Glossy 3D coin as a brand object
bestFor: Brand systems combining photo and cards

vocabulary.definition: A brand card placed over a photograph.
A photo taken from below the subject.
